integrity: All included proofs and verification artifacts describe this one claim. No independent audit or external certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The result is for the scalar Ornstein–Uhlenbeck midpoint discretization with independently drawn positive steps under fixed mean and upper cap.
Asymptotic variance is per update in stationarity, not at a fixed realized physical time. Large randomized steps need not approximate exact trajectories.
Only the first two centered Gaussian Hermite observables are optimized or compared; no statement concerns optimality for all observables or general potentials.
Historical specialized optimization work may provide stronger or equivalent results; no independent audit has occurred.
title: Bounded random time steps optimally trade off Gaussian midpoint autocorrelations
